wording_section: Section 5, Baggage and Personal Effects, and Section 8 add-on 'Electronics Plus'; deductible per Section 1.
reason: The tote bag was snatched from the customer's shoulder in Buenos Aires, which is theft from the person and not an unattended-belongings case, and the theft was reported to the local police the same day, within the 24-hour requirement. The police report and the purchase receipts are on file, so the loss is covered. Each electronics item is paid at its claimed value under the Electronics Plus $1,200 per-item limit, but the handheld game console is not an 'electronics' item as defined for that add-on, so it is capped at the Premium per-item limit of $300; after the $50 Premium deductible the payout is $954.
